facts.rendered_text: SOLO on Chestnut — 4233 Chestnut St, Philadelphia. Built 2020, 7 stories, 281 residential units.
There is a one-time amenity fee of $300 ($250 upon renewal).
The security deposit ranges from $1,000 up to one month's rent, subject to approval conditions.
A $99 admin fee applies per unit, once at move-in and at renewal.
A telecom fee of $75–99 is due at move-in.
All-electric building. Residents pay electric and water based on usage; building wifi (Flume) is $40/month.
Renters insurance is required — residents may bring their own policy or use the building program at $15/month.

Assigned garage parking is $300/month; free bike storage racks are available; there is no free street parking nearby. Current spot availability and any waitlist must be confirmed with the leasing office.
Pet-friendly: a $300 one-time pet fee plus $30/month pet rent. The rooftop includes a dog run.
Furnished units are offered for studios and 1-bedrooms only, subject to availability.
Leases typically run about 12 months on a late-July cycle; short-term or month-to-month is available at a 15–20% premium.

Screening reviews credit history, criminal background, eviction records, and income; decisions typically come within 24–48 hours. Income can be verified with 3 months of pay stubs, an employment offer letter, tax filings, or an I-20 for students. A guarantor option is available.

Move-in requires a $0 balance: application fee, security deposit, amenity fee, and telecom fee paid, with the lease fully executed and government ID plus proof of renters insurance on file. Payments are made through RentCafe or certified funds.

Amenities include a 24/7 gym and indoor golf simulator (floor 2); a 24/7 co-working lounge, game room, bookable movie room, and study room (floor 7); ping-pong rooms (floors 4 and 6); study rooms (floors 3 and 5); and a rooftop with dog run, pergola seating, and green roof. Units have washer-dryer combos, central heating/cooling, and smart home connectivity. 24/7 package lockers include cold storage.

Move-in credits: $500 for first responders, $500 for active military and veterans, and $300 for Penn Dental and Penn Vet affiliates — verification required; applied as a one-time credit after lease execution.
Unit transfers: $750 to upgrade to a larger unit, $1,000 for same-type or downgrades; no fee when upgrading at lease expiration. Requires good standing and management approval.
Unit availability and pricing reflect the property's May 31, 2026 operating report — current availability should be confirmed with the leasing office.
Prospects and residents can text the property line at (215) 445-2021 (reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help). Web inquiries: propertyspine.com. Communications channel information only.
